changes.title: Cross-instance run-index saves
changes.text: Serialize atomic replacement across RunIndex objects so they cannot concurrently truncate or move the same derived temp file.

changes.title: Controlled concurrent index regression
changes.text: Hold one temp stream open, prove a second instance waits, then require both saves and a complete final index without rebuild.

changes.title: TEST170 evidence and TEST171 handoff
changes.text: Preserve verified TEST170 evidence, refresh the UIMSD audit status and record the pending RunIndex concurrency checkpoint.
